name: What is the typical process for installing a bedroom handrail?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for installing a bedroom handrail?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation process begins with an initial consultation to assess your needs, discuss handrail options, and take measurements. Next, we provide a detailed proposal and design plan. Once approved, the installation phase involves preparing the wall or floor, securely mounting the handrail according to safety standards, and ensuring all fixings are robust. We prioritize minimal disruption to your home and conduct a thorough cleanup upon completion. A final inspection ensures the handrail is safe, stable, and meets your expectations.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, design, preparation, secure mounting, and a final inspection to ensure safety and stability.
